note: Wooded campground on a point of the James River arm of Table Rock Lake, with a boat ramp, swim beach, playground and picnic area beside the camping loops. The 50-amp water sites are in the south loop; the north loop's western row runs along the shore road above the beach. --Claude
summary: Confirmed with changes: season May 1 - Sep 15 from the rate table and calendar (was approximate); fees $16-38 (premium sites up to $38, was $23 high); 52 overnight sites (was 55); 50 amp + water on sites 01-21. Lakeview kept for the western-rim sites. Pin is ~210 m NE of the sites in the woods.
flags: FIT: every overnight site lists RV among its equipment (none trailer-only); RV max lengths 17-55 ft, most 30-45 ft, so a 23-ft motorhome has ample choice (sites with 17-22 ft limits: 22, 24, 40, 43, 52, and 20 ft on 01/03/04/46/50).

WATERFRONT (stored lakeview): kept. Measured from the catalog's site points on leaf-off imagery: the western row of the north loop (sites 29-37, 39) sits 50-70 m from the winter shoreline with the shore road, the swim beach or the ramp parking lot between; south-end sites 25/27 ~35 m from the cove with the loop road between. No pad sits at the water with an open apron, so lakefront is not earned; the open beach/lawn below the west row and the rec.gov text ('most sites offering a sweeping view of the water') support a view. Interior sites of both loops (01-21, 40-56) are wooded with no clear view.

PIN: the stored pin (36.6736,-93.4597, the rec.gov facility point) lies ~210 m NE of the camping loops in woods east of the north loop road. Suggest moving it to the loops' centre, about 36.6721,-93.4610 (near site 56 at the junction of the two loops).
PHONE: rec.gov lists 417-739-2792 for the campground; the entry has no phone stored - suggest adding it.
FEES: the rate table carries a $38 peak template on site 5 and $36 on sites 25, 27 and 34 (premium or double sites); the stored $23 high missed them.
Note rewritten: site count, hookups, showers/dump, booking and season removed (the fields hold them).
